title: Tom Ehrle and the Rosenmeiers
summary: Allen asks about Tom Ehrle, a guitar and bass player who worked for Laine; Rosenmeier is not known to Laine.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Do you know Tom Ehrle? I guess you must know.
Who, Ehrle? Tom Ehrle? Well, I hope to tell you I know Tom Ehrle. Guitar and bass player. Yeah, lived on Royal Street. He still does. 1200 block.
Yeah, I see his neighbors, you know, and he comes around to Raymond Burke's place.
Well, you ask Tom about me. Yeah,
we'll go by and see him, maybe.
All right. You ask Tom about me, and Tom will tell you a whole lot about me. Did he work for you? Yes, Tom played music and me.
Yeah. I've heard him talk about the harmony band, you know. Yeah. He had that band. Yeah. Do you know any of the Rosenmeier's? No. Rosenmeier? Rosenmeier, I think they've worked for him. No, I don't.
